overview_description.description: Blixo provides a platform that automatically charges customers using their saved payment information. Set up subscription plans or set recurring invoices to autopay. Send emails, text messages, phone calls, and letters to remind your customers to pay. Customers can download invoices, view and download statements, view and download payment history receipts, manage subscription plans.

about_short_description.short_description: Blixo is a subscription management, and accounts receivable platform.

product.name: Invoice-to-Cash
product.description: A platform feature that automates invoice generation, delivery, and payment collection based on customer and product data.

product.name: Subscription Billing
product.description: A service that manages recurring billing cycles and automates subscription payments for customers.

product.name: Automated Collections
product.description: A system that automates the collection of payments and follow-ups with customers to ensure timely accounts receivable.

product.name: Cash Application
product.description: A tool that automates the matching of incoming payments to invoices, streamlining accounts receivable reconciliation.

product.name: Customer Portal
product.description: A secure online portal where customers can view invoices, make payments, and manage their billing information.
